figurative_meaning_en: To spread or propagate one's good or bad reputation
similar_in_english: To make a name for oneself
To spread one's fame or infamy
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার নাম রটানোর জন্য সে সারা শহরে ঘুরে বেড়াচ্ছে।
গ্রামে তার দুর্নাম রটানো হয়ে গেছে একটা ঘটনার কারণে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is wandering around the city to spread his name.
His ill-repute has spread in the village due to one incident.
note: This idiom reflects everyday social dynamics in Bengali-speaking communities, emphasizing how reputation travels through word-of-mouth.
